findings.binance_por: CoinDesk reports Binance 14, an Ethereum wallet, in the October 1 PoR address set. This supports an ETH-specific reserve concern pending replenishment. It does not establish that any of the five Binance-labelled XRPL source wallets are in the same official address export. Binance's official page exposes a download control, but the underlying file was not retrieved.
findings.binance_incident: Binance's updated statement reports approximately USD6.3B estimated impact and USD3B frozen, says deposits remain unaffected, withdrawals remain paused and all losses will be covered. Frozen is not recovered; aggregate USD is not XRP-specific replenishment.
findings.derivatives: Alpha Finance reports USD2.83B XRP OI and USD39.3M long/short liquidations, materially different from Liqwall's USD1.30B OI at 14:02 UTC. Do not average providers. Alpha heatmap clusters are modelled, not actual executable orders.
findings.etf_flows: XRP Insights reports +3.440288M XRP holdings change Oct26-29 and 1.19665B XRP held Oct29. Holdings deltas include excluded/reconstructed rows and BITW; not direct same-window spot buys. Oct29 session close at 20:00 UTC precedes the first identified XRP transfer at 20:05 UTC.
findings.prediction_engine: No market features admitted. Provider coverage, point-in-time history and outcome labels are insufficient for a calibrated directional forecast. Forecast status remains NOT_ISSUED.
